name: smwmusic-the-12th-vanilla-level-design-contest-desert-zone
title: The 12th Vanilla Level Design Contest - Desert Zone
description:
The song that plays in VLDC12's desert zone. With 6/8 goodness and the underrated combination of @5 and @2 for that arid, adventurous vibe. Hi, little Pokey.




I originally wasn't even supposed to compose this, but it ended up being the last song that nobody else took. It probably ended up being my favourite out of my 3 VLDC12 compositions.

versions.title: The 12th Vanilla Level Design Contest - Desert Zone
